question: What range is covered by the determination of Hākinī accomplishment?
premises: A range beginning with Baddhā is named
It is linked to the determination of Hākinī accomplishment
inference: The determination of Hākinī accomplishment covers the range from Baddhā to Vilakṣaṇā
uncertainties: The verse is compressed and its full syntactic connection may depend on adjacent verses
plain_english: From Baddhā and so forth up to Vilakṣaṇā is the determination of Hākinī accomplishment.
